card.name: Last piece of a drug name before its form
card.fires_on: Final or near-final pieces of a drug's name in label warnings, just before the salt or dosage form (e.g. inhalation solution, Cream, Tablets, Injection). Also the first piece of an opioid name.

modes.label: Name ending before dosage form
modes.description: The closing piece of a drug name, such as -ate, -imus or -en, directly before a form like inhalation solution or Cream.

modes.label: Start of opioid name
modes.description: The opening piece of an opioid name like oxymorphone or hydrocodone, after 'use of' or 'with'.

card.plain: It marks the spot inside a drug name where the name is nearly done and a salt or dosage form comes next.
